Lemon Grass
Also known as citronella grass, lemon grass
has long, green stalks and serrated leaves.
The stalks have a lemony aroma and flavor
tinged with ginger.  Only the lower 4 to 6
inches of the stalk is used.  Lemon grass is
common in Thai and southeast Asian cook-

used in many tomato-based dishes, but it
has a flavor that complements just about
any food.  It is used widely in Mediterranean
cooking and makes an excellent flavoring
for oil and vinegar.  This herb can be used
interchangeably with oregano.  Buy it fresh
when possible.
